view: Frontal chest radiograph, portable AP projection (likely supine/semi-erect); L marker at image upper right, conventional orientation confirmed by cardiac apex and aortic knob on image right
technical_quality: Adequate but limited: patient rotated (asymmetric clavicles, right hemithorax appears larger), mediastinum slightly under-penetrated, inspiration adequate (~9 posterior ribs). Large body habitus with bilateral breast shadows and numerous overlying external cables/tubing degrade assessment of both lower zones and the retrocardiac region.

devices.location: patient's right lateral chest wall, lower zone level (image left)
midline over lower sternum / cardiac silhouette
patient's left anterior chest over the heart, mid-to-lower zone (image right)
long diagonal cable from right upper chest/neck region running infero-laterally across the right hemithorax and off the image at lower left, passing over the right lateral electrode

devices.type: External tubing/cable loop (oxygen tubing or monitoring cable, not intracorporeal)
devices.location: large circular loop projected over the left lower hemithorax and cardiac apex
multiple parallel curvilinear lines projected over the mediastinum and upper abdomen, extending below the diaphragm; no definite nasogastric tube course identified

abnormalities.finding: Hazy airspace opacity / consolidation with partial obscuration of the right hemidiaphragm, suggestive of right lower lobe pneumonia (differential: atelectasis, effusion-related)
Blunting of the right costophrenic angle, possible small right pleural effusion
Enlarged cardiac silhouette (CTR > 0.5) on AP projection; cardiomegaly possible but partly projectional
Widened upper mediastinum, likely due to AP projection, rotation and body habitus rather than true pathology
Bilateral large breast shadows and obesity-related soft tissue increasing lower-zone density bilaterally (technical/soft tissue, not lung pathology)
Rotation to one side with asymmetric clavicular heads (technical)

description_zh: 可攜式前後位胸部X光，病人略有旋轉，體型肥胖且雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野。胸前可見三個心電圖電極及多條外部導線／管線投影於胸腔與上腹部（含左下肺野一大型環狀迴圈），未見明確之氣管內管、中心靜脈導管、鼻胃管或胸管。右下肺野可見模糊之肺泡浸潤／實變，右側橫膈部分模糊、右肋膈角略鈍，疑併少量右側肋膜積液；左肺相對清晰。心影於AP投影下呈擴大，上縱膈增寬可能為投影及旋轉所致；骨骼未見明顯異常。
